mapper.select:
SELECT r.RSV_NO, r.RSV_DATE, r.RSV_START_TIME, r.RSV_END_TIME, r.REQUEST, r.RSV_STATUS,
s.STORE_NAME,
m.MENU_NAME, m.MENU_PRICE, m.M_STATUS,
u.user_id, u.USER_NAME, u.PHONE, u.email
FROM reservation r INNER JOIN store s ON r.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO INNER JOIN store_menu m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO INNER JOIN users u ON r.USER_ID = u.USER_ID WHERE r.RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
SELECT USER_ID, USER_NAME, PHONE, email, user_addr, full_addr FROM USERS WHERE USER_ID = #{userId}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM subscription WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND sub_STATUS = 'Y'

SELECT s.SUB_NO, s.USER_ID, s.SUB_PRICE, s.METHOD_NO, pm.BILLINGKEY FROM subscription s JOIN payment_method pm ON s.METHOD_NO = pm.METHOD_NO WHERE s.SUB_STATUS = 'Y' AND s.IS_AUTO = 'Y' AND DATE(s.N_DATE) = CURDATE()
SELECT c.CART_NO, p.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, p.PRODUCT_PRICE, c.QTY FROM cart c JOIN product p ON c.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO WHERE c.USER_ID = #{userId} AND c.CART_NO IN #{id}

SELECT uc.UCP_NO, c.COUPON_NO, c.COUPON_NAME, c.DEDUCEPRICE, uc.EXP_DATE FROM user_coupon uc JOIN coupon c ON uc.COUPON_NO = c.COUPON_NO WHERE uc.USER_ID = #{userId} AND uc.CP_STATUS = 'RDY' AND uc.EXP_DATE >= NOW()

SELECT d.PRODUCT_NO, p.PRODUCT_NAME, f.FILE_PATH, f.FILE_NAME, d.UNIT_PRICE, d.ORD_QTY FROM order_detail d JOIN product p ON d.PRODUCT_NO = p.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN product_file f ON p.PRODUCT_NO = f.PRODUCT_NO AND f.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE d.ORD_NO = #{id}
SELECT ORD_NO, ORD_ADDR, ORD_MEMO, TOTAL_PRICE, ORD_DATE, DIS_PRICE FROM orders WHERE ORD_NO = #{id}

SELECT r.RSV_NO, r.RSV_DATE, r.RSV_START_TIME, r.RSV_END_TIME, s.STORE_NAME, m.MENU_NAME, m.MENU_PRICE, r.REQUEST FROM reservation r JOIN store s ON r.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO JOIN store_menu m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO WHERE r.RSV_NO = #{id}

SELECT pm.PAY_NO AS payNo, pm.RSV_NO AS rsvNo, pm.TID AS tid, pm.TOTALPRICE AS totalPrice, pm.PAY_STATUS AS payStatus, pm.ORD_NAME AS ordName,
DATE_FORMAT(r.RSV_DATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS rsvDate, TIME_FORMAT(r.RSV_START_TIME, '%H:%i:%s') AS startTime, TIME_FORMAT(r.RSV_END_TIME, '%H:%i:%s') AS endTime, r.RSV_STATUS AS rsvStatus, r.REQUEST AS request,
s.STORE_NAME AS storeName, s.S_ADDR AS storeAddr, m.MENU_NAME AS menuName, m.MENU_PRICE AS menuPrice FROM payment_master pm INNER JOIN reservation r ON pm.RSV_NO = r.RSV_NO LEFT JOIN store s ON r.STORE_NO = s.STORE_NO LEFT JOIN store_menu m ON r.MENU_NO = m.MENU_NO WHERE pm.RSV_NO = #{rsvNo} AND pm.PAY_STATUS = 'PAY'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO payment_master ( USER_ID, METHOD_NO, RSV_NO, ORD_NO, SUB_NO, ORD_NAME, TOTALPRICE, TID, PAY_STATUS, PAY_DATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{methodNo}, #{rsvNo}, #{ordNo}, #{subNo}, #{ordName}, #{totalprice}, #{tid}, #{payStatus}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO subscription ( USER_ID, METHOD_NO, S_DATE, E_DATE, N_DATE, SUB_PRICE, SUB_STATUS, IS_AUTO ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{methodNo}, NOW(), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), #{totalprice}, 'Y', 'Y' )
INSERT INTO payment_method ( USER_ID, PM_NAME, BILLINGKEY, IS_DEFAULT ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{pmName}, #{billingKey}, 'Y')
INSERT INTO user_point ( USER_ID, POINT_AMOUNT, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, -#{usedPoint}, NOW() )

INSERT INTO orders ( USER_ID, COUPON_NO, POINT_NO, DIS_PRICE, TOTAL_PRICE, ORD_ADDR, ORD_MEMO, ORD_STATUS, DELI_STATUS ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{couponNo}, #{pointNo}, #{discountPrice}, #{totalprice}, #{ordAddr}, #{memo}, 'PAY', 'RDY' )
INSERT INTO order_detail ( ORD_NO, PRODUCT_NO, ORD_QTY, UNIT_PRICE ) VALUES ( #{ordNo}, #{PRODUCT_NO}, #{QTY}, #{PRODUCT_PRICE} )
mapper.update: UPDATE reservation SET RSV_STATUS = 'CNF' WHERE RSV_NO = #{rsvNo}
UPDATE subscription SET S_DATE = NOW(), E_DATE = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH), N_DATE = DATE_ADD(NOW(), INTERVAL 1 MONTH) WHERE SUB_NO = #{subNo}
UPDATE user_coupon SET CP_STATUS = 'USE', USE_DATE = NOW() WHERE UCP_NO = #{ucpNo} AND USER_ID = #{userId}
mapper.select: SELECT TID AS IMP_UID, TOTALPRICE AS AMOUNT, PAY_STATUS FROM payment_master WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo}
mapper.update: UPDATE orders SET ORD_STATUS = 'CAN' WHERE ORD_NO = #{ordNo}
UPDATE product p JOIN order_detail od ON p.PRODUCT_NO = od.PRODUCT_NO SET p.STOCK_QTY = p.STOCK_QTY + od.ORD_QTY WHERE od.ORD_NO = #{ordNo}
